status: post-positive audit frozen before robustness outcomes
purpose: Test whether the supported island-year covariance contrast is an artifact of extinction/recolonization zero transitions or dependence on a single island.
frozen_base: Use the same colony standardization, regional-year residualization, pair-year covariance contrast, five rank strata, 20,000 static-label permutations and two-sided p-value as PALMER_ISLAND_YEAR_COHERENCE_V1 unless explicitly changed below.

positive_to_positive_only.change: Retain only annual transitions with positive breeding-pair counts at both start and end; all other rules unchanged.
positive_to_positive_only.rule: robust if both contrasts are positive and both permutation p-values <= 0.05

leave_one_island_out.change: Use the original informative-transition rule, but repeat the all-period analysis five times, each time excluding exactly one of CHR,COR,HUM,LIT,TOR.
leave_one_island_out.rule: not single-island-driven only if all five leave-one-island-out contrasts are positive and all five two-sided permutation p-values <= 0.05

overall_rule: strong robustness requires both the positive-to-positive-only audit and the complete leave-one-island-out audit to pass.
interpretation_boundaries: These are post-positive robustness audits, not independent confirmations.
Failure of any strict audit must be reported rather than repaired by changing thresholds or subsets.
No additional transition threshold, colony minimum, outlier trimming, or island subset may be introduced after outcomes are opened.
